title: Who Should Be on the Panel? Task-Conditioned Persona Selection for LLM Trading Agents
abstract: arXiv:2611.18150v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Multi-agent LLM systems are built by fixing a cast of roles and then designing how the cast coordinates. Which agents should make up the group for a given task is left to the designer, and the same cast is reused for every task. Financial trading makes the cost of that choice visible: stocks trade differently, and the trading styles suited to one need not suit another. We study task-conditioned persona selection, composing the group from the characteristics of the task it will face, and instantiate it with FinPanel, an LLM multi-agent trading system in which a recruiter selects a panel of named trader personas for each stock from a direction-blind statistical sketch of how the stock trades, each persona gives an independent daily call in its own style, and a manager commits the trade after reading the panel's arguments and their desk-kept, hierarchical track records. Because nothing is returned to the traders, the panel stays the panel

translated_title: 谁应该进入专家组？面向LLM交易智能体的任务条件化角色选择
translated_abstract: 多智能体LLM系统通常通过固定一组角色阵容、再设计这些角色如何协作来构建。对于给定任务，哪些智能体应组成团队则交由设计者决定，且同一套角色阵容被重复用于所有任务。金融交易使这一选择的代价清晰可见：不同股票的交易方式各异，适合某一只股票的交易风格未必适合另一只。我们研究任务条件化角色选择，即根据团队将要面对的任务特征来组建智能体阵容，并通过FinPanel将其具体实现——这是一个LLM多智能体交易系统，其中“招聘者”根据每只股票交易行为的方向盲统计概要为其选出一组具名交易员角色，每个角色以自己的风格独立给出每日交易判断，而“管理者”在阅读专家组的论据以及部门保存的分层历史业绩记录后执行交易。由于没有任何信息反馈给交易员，专家组保持稳定……
tldr: 本文提出FinPanel系统，其核心创新在于根据每只股票的交易特征动态选择合适的LLM交易员角色组合，取代传统多智能体系统中固定角色阵容的做法，使智能体团队与具体交易任务相匹配。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes FinPanel, whose key innovation is task-conditioned persona selection—dynamically composing the LLM trader panel for each stock based on its trading characteristics instead of reusing a fixed role cast across all tasks.
